summary: Iter57 - Loan-type canonical-catalog parity. Backend endpoint /api/config/loan-types is CORRECT (3/3 pytest passed: exposes 19 loan types, correct categories/labels, vehicle_loan_values = [new_vehicle_loan, used_vehicle_loan_bt, used_vehicle_loan_fresh]). PUT /api/files/{id}/details persists type_of_loan under file_details.type_of_loan for used_vehicle_loan_bt and business_loan and it round-trips via GET. HOWEVER, the FRONTEND parity is broken: Connect Web File Detail (/admin/files/{id}) does NOT consume the new shared LoanRequirementsSection/useLoanTypes hook. Instead FileDetailsPage.js lines 697-716 renders its OWN hardcoded inline <select> with only 12 options, missing 8 canonical types (balance_transfer_hl, top_up_hl, balance_transfer_topup_hl, msme_loan, lap, gold_loan, education_loan, other), and contains a NON-CANONICAL value 'bt_topup_hl' (canonical is balance_transfer_topup_hl). No optgroup grouping. Save+reload roundtrip works, but read-mode display (line 718) uses fd.type_of_loan.replace(/_/g,' ') so the label shows 'used vehicle loan bt' (lowercase, underscore-swapped) instead of the canonical 'Used Vehicle Loan BT' from the catalog.

rca of the issue: E1 updated the shared LoanRequirementsSection component and the useLoanTypes hook + backend endpoint correctly, but FileDetailsPage.js (which is what actually renders both Connect Web and Meta Web file details) has its own inline <select> for Type of Loan predating the refactor.
